key_insight: An H²-based equilibrated residual framework provides guaranteed finite element error control and polynomial-degree-robust a posteriori lower bounds.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports reliable error assessment for plate bending, Poisson problems, and stress prediction in mixed linear elasticity.
method: Decompose vector- and tensor-valued Sobolev spaces into H² and H¹ components.
Reconstruct symmetric, piecewise-polynomial tensors on vertex patches in broken H(div div) spaces.
Derive equilibrated residual estimates for biharmonic energy error, Poisson L² error, and elasticity stress error.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments illustrate estimator effectiveness, but the abstract reports no quantitative accuracy or computational-cost results.
watch_item: Implementation requires specialized local tensor reconstructions; their computational overhead is not quantified in the abstract.
